summary: General Grocery Store web app with homepage product grid, sticky bottom navigation, admin panel, and shop open/close toggle. User has requested multiple fixes: replace vegetable banners with general grocery banners (Rice, Oil, Biscuits, Snacks), rewrite the shop toggle to directly link to the database and show 'Shop Closed' banner + disable Add to Cart, redesign the Admin Panel with a Dark/Blue Dashboard Theme with stat cards, and ensure 'Delivery in 10 Mins' badge and ₹51 free delivery logic are active on all products.
architectural_notes: Shop toggle must read/write directly to the database and reactively update the storefront (Shop Closed banner + disable Add to Cart)
known_issues: Shop On/Off toggle is broken — not persisting to database or updating UI correctly
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Professional grocery store promotional banner featuring a bag of Basmati rice, cooking oil bottle, and warm golden tones on a clean white background (grocery-banner-rice-oil.dim_1200x400.png)
- Professional grocery store promotional banner featuring biscuit packets and snack bags arranged neatly with a vibrant orange and yellow background (grocery-banner-biscuits-snacks.dim_1200x400.png)

existing_features.title: Replace all vegetable/sabji-themed banners in the HeroBannerCarousel with professional general grocery banners showcasing Rice, Oil, Biscuits, and Snacks. Remove any vegetable or sabji imagery from the homepage entirely.

Delete the existing ShopStatusToggle component code entirely and rewrite it from scratch. The new toggle must call the backend mutation directly and optimistically update UI. When the shop is set to 'Closed': (1) immediately display the ShopClosedBanner on the homepage, (2) disable all 'Add to Cart' buttons across every ProductCard, and (3) block checkout navigation from the CartDrawer. When set to 'Open', all restrictions are lifted immediately.

Redesign the AdminPage with a dark/blue dashboard theme. Replace the current layout with a stats overview row at the top containing three clean metric cards: 'Total Orders' (showing order count), 'Active Users' (showing distinct users with orders), and 'Shop Status' (showing current open/closed state with color indicator). Apply a dark navy/slate background, white/light text, and blue accent colors throughout the admin panel tabs and cards.

Ensure the 'Delivery in 10 Mins' badge is rendered on every ProductCard without exception. Verify that the free delivery threshold logic (free delivery for orders ₹51 and above, ₹5 charge below ₹51 within 1km) is enforced in the CartDrawer total calculation and on the CheckoutPage order summary.
